svg.text: NEW AVALON — ARCHITECTURAL SCHEMATIC II: CONCENTRIC WALLS, SEA HARBOR & WARDS 1–2
Kingdom of Arclean • Merged Canonical Blueprint (Replaces v0.4 Page 22 Hand-Drawn Schematic) • 9-Mile Outer Ring, 1/2-Mile Sea Corridor & Wall Engineering

g.text: D. OVERHEAD PLAN VIEW: CONCENTRIC RINGS, 50 SQ MILE FIELDS & FORTIFIED SEA HARBOR
Strict Spire weapon/armor bans are unenforced in the 50 sq mi Fields Ring (workers carry axes/pistols) and completely unenforced beyond the Outer Wall
50 SQ MILES: AGRICULTURAL FIELDS & HEAVY INDUSTRY
(Crops, Livestock, Blast Foundries, Tanneries • Workers Carry Axes/Pistols)
E. WALL ENGINEERING CROSS-SECTIONS (OUTER, DOCK & INNER)
Reinforced Neithercrete & stone ramparts with internal bomb-proof galleries and Arms Bunkers
F. LOWER SPIRE CUTAWAY: WARDS 1 & 2 AND INNER WALL CONNECTION
50 fortified Ramps/Bridges span the 50-ft moat from the 150-ft Inner Wall directly into Ward 2 (Soldier Ward)
WARD 2 • UPPER SOLDIER WARD (200 FT TALL)
• Heavy Artillery Storage & Siege Magazines ("300 feet uppers")
• First reinforced exterior observation windows (500+ ft above surface)
WARD 2 • MID SOLDIER WARD (100 FT TALL)
Crown regiment barracks, drill halls, muster yards & tactical command
WARD 2 • LOWER SOLDIER WARD (100 FT TALL)
Bridgeheads for 50 Inner Wall Ramps • Largest Expeditionary Arms Bunkers
WARD 1 • UPPER LABOR WARD (75–100 FT TALL)
Teamster dormitories, tool depots & Peasant Path Lower Terminus lifts
WARD 1 • MID LABOR WARD (75–100 FT • GROUND LEVEL)
Reinforced Surface Blast Gates to Agricultural Fields & Sea Port Corridor
WARD 1 • LOWER LABOR WARD (75–100 FT • UNDERGROUND)
Sub-surface bulk storage, root cellars, cisterns & heavy freight vaults
DEEP SUBTERRANEAN • THE WARRENS & ANCIENT SUMPS
Geothermal Exchange Pipes, flooded pre-Wilheart ruins & hidden smuggler sea caves
